g.text: PA1 senses VBUS_FUSED through a 100k/100k divider; PG10 reads the eFuse fault pin.

g.text: BOOT0 and RESET use B3U tact switches. Indicator LEDs are active-low GPIO sinks.

g.text: PB13/PB14 are reserved for UCPD CC1/CC2; sensor SPI2 uses PB10/PC2/PC3 instead.
